BiblicalUsage: Osnappar, written Asnappar in Ezra 4:10, is the great and noble king of Assyria who brought foreign peoples over and settled them in the cities of Samaria. His name appears once, in the letter the Samaritans wrote to stop the rebuilding of the temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the peoples Osnappar planted became the mixed Samaria of the Gospels, and the king who moved nations could not move the purpose of God.
